description.text: AI-written synthesis of the official page retrieved in this pass, prepared by the collecting assistant: Join the Deep-Tech League FAQ Careers News & events Join the Deep-Tech League Founders Investors Partners Building deep tech ventures to solve grand societal challenges. Become a co-founder ​HighTechXL is the Netherlands’ premier deep tech venture builder, solving societal challenges by combining groundbreaking technologies and entrepreneurship. In fact, we bring together and activate technology, talent, funding and a strong ecosystem in our unique Venture Building Program. At HighTechXL, we support founders as they progress through our 1-year Deep Tech Venture Builder Program, and in addition, we connect them with essential resources, such as investors, advisors, and customers. The journey starts by scouting groundbreaking technologies at TRL3+, then, we identify the most promising ones from major tech institutes like CERN , European Space Agency (ESA) , TNO , Philips and other global innovators. Next, we promote a structured cofounder selection process to tap into a pool of vetted talented entrepreneurs. This, together with a validated market opportunity, is the entry ticket into the program. Read more about us No application form was opened, and this record does not add a deadline, investment instrument, or eligibility rule beyond that quoted text.
